name: Monday Night Adrenaline — 11/21

date.source: The fed's own served broadcast dates itself "Monday Night Adrenaline 11-21"; the page's own closing line, "Generated by Zeus Pro Copyright 2000," is the simulator software's own copyright notice, not the fed's own founding or airdate claim. The held record's roster (John Cena, Randy Orton) and the fed's own pbm.com listing (observed 2005) both place the show in the mid-2000s — the "11-21" dateline is read as 21 November of that era.

matches.note: For the CZWF Women's Championship. Chyna forced Trish Stratus to submit to a chicken wing, after a mid-match chair shot opened Stratus up; the CZWF Women's Championship changed hands.
For the CZWF Intercontinental Championship. "Super Crazy" AJ Warner forced Rey Mysterio to submit to an elbow submission hold; the CZWF Intercontinental Championship changed hands.

matches.stipulation: No. 1 Contendership of the CZWF X-Division Championship
matches.note: Andre the Giant pinned Randy Orton after a Super DDT to become the No. 1 contender for the CZWF X-Division Championship, held by John Cena — no title changed hands.
Zade pinned HippieDude off a backslide, following a floor brawl and a series of finishing moves.
Corey "Iceman" Morrish pinned The Kat with a shooting star press.

For the CZWF Heavyweight Championship. The Undertaker sent reigning champion Iron Bull through a table to win the match; the CZWF Heavyweight Championship changed hands, part of an already-ongoing rivalry the fed's own recap calls a "seesaw gone wrong."

notes: The fed's own weekly TV show, its own matches generated by the Zeus Pro simulator engine. Three titles changed hands on the card — the CZWF Women's, Intercontinental and Heavyweight Championships — and a fourth title's No. 1 contender was decided.
